args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, failing tests/test_money.py. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build fails because `src/money.py` claimed to implement banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` fails.

## Changes
- Replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` so amounts are rounded to cents using banker's rounding, matching the docstring and FIN-212.

## Validation
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed (includes `tests/test_money.py`).
